Read-only measuring is fine meanwhile. Worktree `objectstack-issue-27378` on that branch from a fresh `origin/main` (`git checkout --detach` the main checkout first, then `git worktree add --no-track -B <branch> ../objectstack-issue-27378 origin/main`); `pnpm install` (frozen lockfile); push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, F a bare JSON array `[{"op":"pr_create","title":…,"head":"<your branch>","base":"main","body":…,"assignees":["os-warren"]}]`, draft forced; `--dry-run` first); your report comment through `node scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs --comment=27378 --file=F --json` run ONCE with output captured to a file (no time-shaped stamp inside the fenced report JSON). ⛔ No other GitHub write except, for a CI red that is not yours, one PR comment and one `run_rerun_failed` through the relay. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names). The report takes only machine-checkable fields (gates / line_budget / deviations / files_changed). PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, line 3 `Fixes #27378`, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran` (merge `origin/main` first if it refuses as STALE TREE); `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card. Build the closure your tests import first (`bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh -c "pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '<pkg>^...' build"`). Changeset in the root `.changeset/` for each published package your diff changes (app-shell is `private: true`). ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green. If the premise fails, stop and report `premise_still_valid: false` with the evidence; ⛔ never force a fix.


### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

objectui#13159 (CHANGELOG 673a71c) keeps the switch on this page showing AND writing the activation flag on a flow the engine does not run. Keep that: the switch stays enabled, `checked` stays `row.enabled`, and toggling still writes the flag. This card changes only how a not-running row LOOKS and what its visible words say. The server's reason sentence is not rewritten. It stays verbatim behind the Details chip (`ReasonDetails`).

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` c4c515ad (read-only):
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/PackagedAutomationPage.tsx`:
  - The `Switch` at ≈L661 uses the default primary checked track.
  - The `reading` (`on` / `not-running` / `off`) drives the Badge at ≈L675–686.
  - `unboundCause` is read for presence only (≈L250).
- Strings come from `t('packagedAutomation.*', { defaultValue })`, with bundles in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`. Measure which parity gates bind a new key (every locale, or en + zh plus fallback). Follow what the existing `packagedAutomation.notRunning` key does.
- Seat 1's PR #27376 (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` AutomationsPillar) mutes a read-only switch's track. Borrow its CLASS for the visual if it fits. Do not import its disabling.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

1. When `reading === 'not-running'`, give the Switch a muted checked track (a className override, or the #27376 class). The thumb position, `aria-checked`, `disabled` and `onCheckedChange` stay unchanged.
2. When `unboundCause === 'deployment_policy'`, the visible badge or line reads a plain, localized sentence keyed on the cause, e.g. "On, but this deployment does not run scheduled work". The other causes, and a row with no cause, keep "Not running here". Details still opens the server sentence.
3. Tests, beside the existing `PackagedAutomationPage.test.tsx`:
   - a `deployment_policy` row draws the muted track and the plain sentence, and Details still holds the server sentence;
   - CONTROL: a bound row keeps the primary track and "On";
   - CONTROL: a `binding_failure` row keeps "Not running here";
   - CONTROL: the switch on a not-running row still toggles and writes;
   - ablation: drop the muted class or the cause branch, and the first test goes red.

### Scope

File surface:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/**`
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts`, only the new key or keys
- tests beside them
- root `.changeset/`

Do not touch `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, which is seat 1's #27376. Do not touch any server or service-automation file.

### Tier

`TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `low` (S). `Clause-②: no`. `Metadata-protocol: none`. Not governed. Changeset: app-shell is private, so `@object-ui/i18n` takes a patch if a locale key ships. Measure whether that package is published.
